blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recovering real-world geometry and motion from images and videos is a central
problem in computer vision. Traditional reconstruction systems recover scenes
through feature matching, camera pose estimation, and geometric optimization.
While these methods benefit from explicit geometric constraints, they depend
on reliable visual correspondences and sufficient overlap between views.
Textureless regions, repetitive structures, wide baselines, and scene dynamics
introduce uncertainty that can compromise both camera estimation and geometry
recovery. As the number of input views increases, maintaining scene consistency can also incur
substantial computational cost. Balancing reconstruction quality, efficiency,
and robustness to complex scenes therefore remains an important challenge.

blocks.en:
Geometry foundation models offer a new approach to these challenges. Through
large-scale pretraining, they learn transferable spatial priors and directly
predict cameras, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic geometry from
visual observations. These predictions provide information where conventional
geometric constraints are insufficient. However, model predictions do not
inherently satisfy cross-view and temporal consistency across an entire scene,
particularly for long sequences, large environments, and dynamic observations.
Spatial priors and geometric optimization are therefore complementary: the
former provide useful predictions and initialization, while the latter
integrate them into coherent scene structure. The objective is not to
eliminate optimization altogether, but to exploit model capabilities to reduce
the optimization required for reliable reconstruction.

Following this principle, we build Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system
that combines a geometry foundation model, GFM, with a pose optimization
engine, PoseEngine. GFM estimates camera parameters, depth, cross-view
correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos, providing
spatial priors for both static geometry recovery and dynamic scene
understanding. PoseEngine leverages these outputs to efficiently recover
scene-level camera poses and geometry, supporting the subsequent construction
of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) representations for static scenes and 4D
Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) ( Wu et al., 2024 ) representations for dynamic scenes. The system thus
connects geometric predictions from visual observations to scene-level
reconstruction and renderable 3D and 4D representations.

Beyond integrating the model and optimization engine, Kosmo-GFM emphasizes the
continued improvement of spatial priors. We use high-quality real-world
reconstruction data from KosmoWorld to train and improve GFM’s understanding
of scene geometry. As GFM improves, more reliable predictions can reduce
uncertainty in subsequent geometry recovery and lessen the reliance on
explicit optimization, providing a basis for simpler pose optimization and
higher system efficiency. We therefore evaluate not only the accuracy of GFM’s
predictions, but also their practical role in the complete reconstruction
system.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned geometric prediction, cross-view matching, and scene-level optimization address complementary requirements of 3D and dynamic reconstruction. Learned models provide geometry and motion priors, matching connects observations across views, and scene-level optimization strengthens geometric consistency. This section reviews 3D reconstruction, 4D reconstruction, matching, and pose estimation systems from this perspective. Kosmo-GFM combines a shared geometry model with PoseEngine and reconstruction-derived training supervision from KosmoWorld, bringing learned prediction and geometric constraints together within a single reconstruction system.

blocks.zh: 2.1 三维重建

blocks.en:
Static reconstruction recovers scene geometry and camera parameters from
images or videos. Beyond prediction accuracy, its practical scope depends
on how observations are processed and which camera models are supported.

关于如何处理观测以及支持何种相机模型。

DUSt3R formulates reconstruction from uncalibrated image pairs as point-map
regression ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , and MASt3R couples this geometry with local
descriptors for matching ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) . Fast3R and MUSt3R extend
pairwise prediction to multiple views in a common coordinate frame,
reducing the need to align separate pairwise reconstructions ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Cabon et al., 2025 ) . VGGT predicts multiple geometric attributes
jointly ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , whereas π 3 \pi^{3} removes dependence on a designated
reference view through a permutation-equivariant architecture ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
SAIL-Recon scales scene regression by localizing additional images against
an anchor-based neural scene representation ( Deng et al., 2026b ) , while
FastVGGT reduces inference cost through training-free token
merging ( Shen et al., 2026 ) .

Streaming methods update a scene as observations arrive, balancing the

Point3R associates explicit spatial pointers with scene
locations ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . StreamVGGT uses causal attention and cached
features ( Zhuo et al., 2026 ) , and STream3R formulates sequential point-map
prediction with a causal decoder-only transformer ( Lan et al., 2026b ) .
WinT3R combines windowed inference with a global camera-token
pool ( Li et al., 2026d ) .

controlling drift and forgetting. TTT3R

and LingBot-Map combines an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a

its memory formulation, but does not require strictly causal inference.

reconstruction ( Zhou et al., 2026b ) , and VGGT4D mines motion cues from a
pretrained geometry transformer’s attention to suppress dynamic interference
in camera and geometry estimation without additional
training ( Hu et al., 2026b ) . These methods predict cameras and geometry
rather than scene motion. They address motion-induced
inconsistency, complementing the memory and sequence-length concerns of
streaming reconstruction.

Panoramas offer wide spatial coverage, but spherical distortion and
projection discontinuities limit direct transfer from perspective-image
models. PanoSplatt3R adapts perspective pretraining to unposed, wide-baseline
panoramas ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . PanoVGGT instead incorporates
modeling that accounts for spherical geometry to jointly predict cameras and dense geometry
from panoramic inputs ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . PaGeR adapts a perspective-pretrained
geometry transformer using mixed perspective and panoramic training, jointly
estimating depth, surface normals, and sky masks ( Bozic et al., 2026 ) .
Data coverage is also important:
Holo360D provides real-world continuous panoramic trajectories with aligned
geometry and camera poses, supporting both training and evaluation ( Ou et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
Argus targets metric indoor reconstruction, using learned co-visibility
to choose a reference view and geometric constraints to couple prediction
branches ( Li et al., 2026b ) . CasaMaestro reconstructs house-scale geometry
and camera poses from sparse multi-view panoramas ( Ji et al., 2026 ) .
Together, these works extend panoramic reconstruction from adapting
perspective priors to collecting suitable supervision and maintaining
metric consistency across large indoor spaces.

blocks.en:
General camera models extend reconstruction beyond a fixed pinhole
assumption. Wid3R conditions reconstruction on the camera
model ( Jung et al., 2026 ) . CAM3R predicts ray directions and scene geometry
for uncalibrated wide-angle images ( Guruprasad et al., 2026 ) , whereas X-Lens estimates metric
depth from calibrated, heterogeneous fisheye and pinhole views ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) .
Fisheye3R adapts pretrained multi-view models to fisheye projection while
retaining perspective-image capability ( Duan et al., 2026 ) . RayTun3R instead
adapts lightweight position- and camera-related components on a short segment
of the test sequence, leaving the pretrained backbone fixed ( Sinitsyn et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
Other approaches address camera heterogeneity through training data or
ray-based representations. MEOW learns mixed-camera reconstruction from
procedurally rendered training tuples without requiring camera-type labels
or calibration at inference ( Li et al., 2026a ) . G-ray parameterizes rotary
position encodings using camera-local ray angles ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
Any3R uses a supplied dense ray field to condition angular positional
encoding and solid-angle-weighted supervision, supporting heterogeneous
central cameras in one reconstruction ( Chen et al., 2026a ) . At the single-image
level, OmniPoint decouples ray direction from distance to predict metric
point clouds across pinhole, fisheye, and panoramic projections, with
optional geometric priors ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . These methods differ in
whether calibration is supplied or inferred, whether adaptation is required,
and whether they predict single-view geometry or jointly recover cameras
and structure from multiple views.

blocks.en: 2.2 4D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 4D 重建

blocks.en:
Dynamic reconstruction must recover time-varying geometry while separating
scene motion from camera motion. Occlusion, reappearance, and long-range
association make independently predicted depth maps insufficient for
describing how scene points move. We therefore use 4D reconstruction for
methods that explicitly model scene flow, dynamic points, or point
trajectories over time. Methods that estimate only cameras and per-frame
geometry in dynamic scenes are discussed under 3D reconstruction.
Dynamic Point Maps extend point-map regression to spatial and temporal
references, supporting geometry, scene flow, and correspondence prediction
from image pairs ( Sucar et al., 2025 ) . St4RTrack jointly reconstructs and tracks
dynamic content through paired point maps in a world coordinate
frame ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . SpatialTrackerV2 (SpaTrackerV2) combines geometry, camera motion, and point motion in a
feed-forward tracker ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . Any4D jointly predicts
metric geometry and motion across multiple frames ( Karhade et al., 2026 ) ,
while V-DPM extends dynamic point maps to video to represent scene structure
and per-point 3D motion ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) . Flow4R uses relative scene flow to
connect geometry and motion in two-view prediction ( Qian et al., 2026 ) .
Track4World uses a shared video representation and 3D correlation to estimate
dense flow between selected frame pairs and recover world-centric
trajectories ( Lu et al., 2026a ) .

blocks.en:
Trajectory representations make temporal continuity explicit. Shape of
Motion fits shared motion bases per scene using depth and long-range 2D
tracks as priors ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
Trace Anything predicts continuous per-pixel 3D trajectories parameterized
by control points ( Liu et al., 2026a ) . OmniX represents dense motion
with trajectory fields ( Jiang et al., 2026b ) . SM4RT uses structured motion bases
to model coordinated point motion ( Lin et al., 2026c ) , while Point4D extends
query-based trajectory prediction to long video sequences ( Jeon et al., 2026 ) .
MoVieS links geometry and motion to rendering through moving, pixel-aligned
Gaussian primitives, supporting dynamic view synthesis and point
tracking ( Lin et al., 2026a ) .

blocks.en:
Query-based models offer a complementary way to access dynamic geometry
without decoding every point at every time. D4RT exposes point-level
spatiotemporal queries ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
4RC conditionally decodes geometry and motion from an encoded
clip ( Luo et al., 2026 ) .
UniQuery4R selects the source view, target view, and a continuous
source-pixel coordinate at decoding time ( Chen et al., 2026c ) . Fast Spatial Tracking combines global and
frame-level query features to predict trajectories from geometry-grounded
video features ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . L4P shares a video encoder across
depth, optical flow, and point tracking, while retaining lightweight
task-specific heads ( Badki et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en:
ARROW broadens the input setting from a single ordered video to arbitrary
image sets, using order-invariant queries to associate observations across
viewpoints and capture times ( Fradlin et al., 2026 ) . Across these methods,
the main distinctions concern whether motion is represented by pairwise
displacement, continuous trajectories, structured motion, or conditional
queries, and how each representation handles visibility and temporal extent.

图像集,使用顺序变化式查询来关联横跨的观测

blocks.en: 2.3 Matching
blocks.zh: 2.3 匹配

blocks.en:
Visual correspondences connect image observations to geometric constraints.
Dense matching emphasizes coverage, sparse matching limits computational
cost, and multi-view matching or tracking seeks consistency across more
than two observations.

blocks.en:
RoMa combines frozen DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) coarse features with fine convolutional
features and a transformer match decoder for robust dense
matching ( Edstedt et al., 2024 ) . RoMa v2 further studies architecture,
training distribution, and efficient refinement for difficult image
pairs ( Edstedt et al., 2026 ) . UFM unifies optical flow and wide-baseline matching
as dense displacement prediction ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) . These methods provide
constraints across a broader image area than sparse keypoints, although
their use in reconstruction still requires handling visibility and
unreliable correspondences.

blocks.en:
Sparse pipelines separate the selection and description of keypoints from
their association across images. DISK learns local features through a
matching-oriented reinforcement-learning objective ( Tyszkiewicz et al., 2020 ) . ALIKED
uses sparse deformable descriptors for efficient extraction ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , while
DaD studies descriptor-free keypoint learning and detector
distillation ( Edstedt et al., 2025 ) . At the matching stage, LightGlue adapts
computation to the difficulty of an image pair ( Lindenberger et al., 2023 ) ,
and LoMa revisits local matching through model and data
scaling ( Nordström et al., 2026 ) . Detector quality, descriptor
discriminability, and assignment accuracy thus contribute separately to
the reliability and cost of sparse geometric constraints.

blocks.en:
Reliable pairwise matches do not automatically form consistent multi-view
tracks. VGGSfM uses point tracks in a differentiable SfM
pipeline ( Wang et al., 2024a ) . CoTracker3 learns 2D tracking from real-video
pseudo-labels ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) , while SpatialTrackerV2 jointly models scene
geometry, camera motion, and 3D point motion ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
MV-RoMa jointly matches a source image to multiple targets and constructs
tracks for reconstruction ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . MVLoMa instead combines
features from geometry foundation models with sparse center–neighbor matching on a
star graph ( Lu et al., 2026b ) . These approaches differ in whether they
associate dense pixels, sparse keypoints, or tracked points, while sharing
the aim of using information from multiple observations jointly.

blocks.en:
Geometry-assisted trackers explicitly use external geometric estimates.
The earlier SpatialTracker, the predecessor of SpatialTrackerV2, lifts
pixels to 3D with monocular depth and represents each
frame with a triplane ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) . DELTA combines global–local
attention with trajectory upsampling for dense 3D tracking ( Ngo et al., 2025b ) , whereas
DELTAv2 reduces its cost through coarse-to-fine trajectory expansion and
more efficient correlation computation ( Ngo et al., 2025a ) . TAPIP3D uses
depth and camera motion to construct stabilized 3D feature clouds, in which
local attention refines point trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .

blocks.en:
With synchronized, calibrated cameras, MVTracker fuses multi-view features
and depth into a common 3D cloud ( Rajič et al., 2025 ) . MV-TAP uses camera
geometry and cross-view attention to track 2D points across video
streams ( Koo et al., 2026 ) , whereas LAPA combines appearance and geometric
constraints through attention to recover multi-camera 3D
trajectories ( Galoaa et al., 2026 ) . These methods exploit complementary views to reduce ambiguity and occlusion. They assume supplied camera calibration, whereas joint reconstruction and tracking from unposed RGB also require estimating camera parameters.

blocks.en: 2.4 Pose Estimation Systems
blocks.zh: 2.4 Pose估算系统

blocks.en:
Pose estimation systems recover cameras in a shared coordinate frame and
usually estimate scene structure alongside them. These systems fall into
three families according to whether they use no learned geometric or pose priors, geometric priors only, or both geometric and camera-pose priors.
blocks.zh:
Pose估计系统在一个共用坐标框架内回收相机,
通常与它们一起估计场景结构. 这些系统属于
3个家庭,根据是没有使用所学的几何或外形前身,只使用几何前身,还是同时使用几何和相机前身.

blocks.en:
Classical SfM combines visual correspondences with multi-view geometry to
estimate cameras and sparse structure. COLMAP provides an incremental
reconstruction pipeline ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ) , while GLOMAP revisits
global SfM: after rotation averaging, it jointly estimates camera positions
and 3D points in a single global positioning step instead of separate
translation averaging and triangulation, bringing global SfM close to
incremental accuracy and robustness ( Pan et al., 2024 ) .
Their explicit geometric constraints remain valuable for scene-level
consistency, although reliable correspondences and adequate observation
geometry are important for successful reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
经典 SfM 将视觉相通和多视图几何合并到
估计相机和稀有结构 COLMAP 提供了递增
重建管道 (Schönberger和Frahm,2016年),而GLOMAP则重新审视.
全球SfM:在平均旋转后,它联合估计相机位置
和三维点在单个全球定位系统中而不是分开
平均翻译和三角化,使全球SfM接近
增量精度和坚固度(Pan等,2024.) .
其明显的几何限制对于场景一级仍然有价值
一致性,尽管是可靠的函证和适当的观察
几何对成功的重建很重要.

blocks.en:
This family retains geometric estimation while introducing learned depth
or surface information. MP-SfM combines monocular depth and normal priors
with multi-view constraints ( Pataki et al., 2025 ) . MegaSaM targets camera and
depth recovery from casual dynamic videos ( Li et al., 2025 ) , while ViPE
estimates intrinsics, camera motion, and dense depth across diverse video
and camera settings ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . VidMap exploits video temporal
structure and depth priors ( Pataki et al., 2026 ) . Marginalized bundle
adjustment mitigates the high error variance of dense monocular depth when
estimating multi-view cameras ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Their common motivation is to strengthen
geometric evidence when appearance-based constraints alone are unreliable,
rather than replace scene-level estimation with independent predictions.

或地面资料。 MP- SfM 结合了单向深度和正常前缀

blocks.en:
Foundation models can also provide initial cameras together with local
geometry. MASt3R-SfM integrates model-derived reconstruction and
matching ( Duisterhof et al., 2025 ) . VGGT-SLAM and VGGT-Long combine
local predictions across longer sequences ( Maggio et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026c ) .
VGGT-SLAM++ adds DEM-based submap association and frequent local bundle
adjustment for large-scale mapping with bounded memory ( Mandal et al., 2026 ) .
GLUEMAP runs feed-forward inference on local star graphs filtered by
Doppelgangers++ ( Xiangli et al., 2025 ) and fuses multiple track types in bundle adjustment, gaining
robustness to symmetry, appearance change, and low
overlap ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . Glob3R also integrates feed-forward
predictions into global reconstruction ( Deng et al., 2026a ) , while GeoWeaver studies
hierarchical assembly and refinement of geometric
priors ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) . HiP3R first aligns local reconstructions with a
chunk-level Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) pose graph, then refines a shared SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) camera for each frame under the fixed global layout. This
hierarchy reconciles overlapping predictions without retraining the
underlying reconstruction model ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
These systems combine learned initialization
with cross-view constraints to improve consistency beyond individual
prediction windows, with different choices for organizing observations
and controlling optimization cost.

blocks.en: 3 Kosmo-GFM

blocks.en: This section introduces the three complementary components of Kosmo-GFM and how they work together (Figure 2 ). GFM uses shared multi-view features to predict cameras, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic points, with optional camera conditioning. PoseEngine combines these priors with cross-view constraints to recover scene cameras for dense geometry prediction and subsequent rendering. KosmoWorld converts real-world reconstructions into training supervision; the reported ablation shows improvements in depth and relative-pose prediction. Together, these components connect multi-task geometric prediction, scene-level camera recovery, and training-data construction, supporting a range of static and dynamic reconstruction outputs.

blocks.en: Scene extent and observation distance vary substantially across scenes. For the RGB-only model, we define a global scale as the mean distance of all valid 3D points across the input views to the first camera center. Depth, 3D points, and camera translations are divided by this shared scale. This preserves relative geometry within each scene while bringing supervision across scenes into comparable numerical ranges.
blocks.zh: 场景范围和观测距离因场景而有很大差异. 对于只使用RGB的模型,我们定义一个全球尺度,即所有有效的3D点在输入视图到第一个相机中心之间的平均距离. 深度,3D点,相机翻译均被这个共享的尺度所分出. 这保留了每个场景内的相对几何特征,同时将跨场景的监督带入可比较的数字范围.

blocks.en: For camera-conditioned models, predicted geometry should follow the input camera poses, and predictions from different chunks should be mapped back to a common scale. We therefore define the pose scale using the maximum distance from an input camera center to the first camera center: s pose = max i ⁡ ‖ C i − C 1 ‖ 2 . s_{\mathrm{pose}}=\max_{i}\|C_{i}-C_{1}\|_{2}. (13) Here C i C_{i} denotes an input camera center. The implementation applies a lower-bound safeguard to very small normalization factors. With this scale as a shared reference, we trained two models, each using one of the following schemes.

blocks.en: Scheme 1: direct pose-scale normalization. Camera translations, depth, and 3D points are divided by s pose s_{\mathrm{pose}} , and the model directly predicts geometry in pose-normalized units. Each chunk may use a different normalization factor. As long as the input poses share the same coordinate units, reversing each chunk’s normalization and reference-frame transform restores its geometry to the common input-pose coordinate system. This provides a consistent scale reference for cross-chunk reconstruction.

blocks.en: 3.1.4 View Sampling

We sample training clips with deliberately low inter-frame co-visibility, reducing redundant observations of the same scene content. Low-overlap observations encourage the model to learn more precise features for establishing correspondences across viewpoints. To select the temporal interval, we examine how the co-visibility distribution changes with frame separation and choose a step where its lower bound approaches zero. Figure 4 illustrates this sampling criterion on ScanNet ( Dai et al., 2017 ) . For V V input views, we form a temporal window of V × step V\times\mathrm{step} frames and resample V V views within it. The interval is chosen separately for each data source, and it is not a requirement that every sampled view pair have zero overlap.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取训练片段,刻意降低机身间共相可视性,减少同一场景内容的冗余观察. 低重叠观测鼓励该模型学习更精确的特征,以建立跨观点的对应关系。 为了选择时间间隔,我们研究了共相可视性分布如何随着帧分离而变化,并选择其下限接近零的一步. 图4说明了ScanNet上的这一取样标准(Dai等人,2017年)。 对于 V V 输入视图,我们组成了 V\\ step V\times\mathrm{step} 帧和再模拟 V V 视图的时间窗口 。 对每个数据源分别选择间隔,并不是要求每个被采样的视图对都有零重叠.

blocks.en: 3.1.5 Camera-conditioned GFM
blocks.zh: 3.1.5 相机设备GFM

blocks.en: We obtain Camera-conditioned GFM by further training the RGB-only GFM. It takes images or video frames with known per-frame camera intrinsics and extrinsics and predicts a dense point cloud for each frame. A prompt camera encoder maps each frame’s camera parameters to a prompt camera token.
blocks.zh: 我们通过进一步训练只使用RGB的GFM来获得相机条件的GFM. 它利用已知的每帧相机内在和外相机的图像或视频帧,预测出每个相机的密度点云. 一个即时相机编码器将每个帧的相机参数映射为即时相机符号.

blocks.en: Unlike Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2026b ) , we replace the first register token with the prompt token instead of replacing the camera token. Directly replacing the camera token lets prompt information flow directly to the camera head. This can substantially improve camera accuracy, but risks an information shortcut: the camera head can reproduce the supplied parameters while patch tokens make limited use of them. Our design encourages both camera and patch tokens to integrate the prompt information for dense geometry prediction.
blocks.zh: 与"深度Anything 3"(Lin等,2026b)不同,我们用快活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 直接取而代之的相机符号可以使信息迅速直接流到相机头. 这可以大幅度地提高相机的准确性,但有风险的是信息快捷方式:相机头可以复制所提供参数而补丁符则有限地使用. 我们的设计鼓励相机和补丁符号将即时信息集成,用于密度几何预测.

blocks.en: We also construct training samples with no inter-frame co-visibility, encouraging both token types to use camera prompts without visual correspondences. Table 4 in Section 4.1.1 reports the results.

blocks.en: To extend GFM beyond pinhole imagery, we incorporate fisheye and panoramic observations during training. Compared with conventional pinhole cameras, fisheye and panoramic cameras offer a wider field of view. This broader coverage can provide more multi-view constraints in latent space, enabling more accurate camera poses and more efficient reconstruction. Figure 5 compares camera-token attention under pinhole-only and pinhole-plus-fisheye training. It provides a qualitative view of the change in cross-view feature aggregation. Figure 6 shows reconstruction with mixed pinhole and fisheye cameras, and Figure 7 shows reconstruction with panoramic cameras.

blocks.en: 3.2 PoseEngine
blocks.zh: 3.2 锅炉引擎

blocks.en: Feed-forward predictions provide a strong geometric initialization, but scene reconstruction also requires consistency across many observations. Inspired by GLUEMAP ( Pan et al., 2026 ) , PoseEngine combines GFM priors with optimization and organizes reconstruction around STARs, each consisting of one center image and its neighbors. It provides two STAR construction schemes for different input types.
blocks.zh: Feed-wardward的预测提供了强烈的几何初始化,但场景重建也需要在许多观测中保持一致. 受GLUEMAP(Pan等,2026年)的启发,PoseEngine将GFM前身与优化结合,并围绕STAR组织重建,每组由1个中心图像及其相邻者组成. 它为不同的输入类型提供了两个STAR构建方案.

blocks.en: For unordered image collections, PoseEngine follows the STAR construction scheme of GLUEMAP ( Pan et al., 2026 ) : it retrieves candidate neighbors with SALAD ( Izquierdo and Civera, 2024 ) global descriptors and verifies them with Doppelgangers++ ( Xiangli et al., 2025 ) , forming STARs of 26 images. For ordered sequences, each STAR is built mainly from temporally adjacent frames, supplemented by a small number of SALAD-retrieved frames, again totaling 26 images. We compare both STAR policies in the matching study, while the main reconstruction benchmark uses the ordered policy, labeled PoseEngine .
blocks.zh: 对于无序图像收藏,PoseEngine遵循了GLUEMAP(Pan等,2026年)的STAR构建方案:它检索了与SALAD(Izquierdo和Civera,2024年)的候选邻居,并用多双版++验证它们. (Xiangli等,2025年),由26个图像组成STAR. 对于所订购的序列,每个STAR主要由时间相邻的帧来构建,由少量的SALAD-检索帧来补充,再次总计26个图像. 我们比较两个STAR政策在匹配研究中, 而主要重建基准使用命令政策,

blocks.en: Within each STAR, PoseEngine matches the center image to every neighbor in a single pass using the MVLoMa decoder of GFM. For STAR inputs, a single GFM forward pass therefore provides both geometric priors and correspondences without requiring additional images or new image pairings. The evaluated implementation uses a LoMa Large fallback for inputs of at most 26 images.
blocks.zh: 在每个STAR内部,PoseEngine使用GFM的MVLOMA解码器,将中心图像匹配到每个相邻的单个通路中. 因此,对于STAR输入,单一的GFM前传既提供几何前传又提供函证,而不需要额外的图像或新的图像配对. 评估的执行采用LoMa Lige回落法,最多输入26个图像。

blocks.en: The stronger GFM becomes, the simpler PoseEngine can be: more accurate camera and geometry priors require fewer bundle-adjustment rounds, which substantially reduces system runtime. Section 4.2 supports this view, as PoseEngine achieves higher mean pose accuracy than GLUEMAP with substantially lower cumulative runtime.
blocks.zh: GFM变强后,PoseEngine可以变简单:更准确相机和几何前作需要更少的捆绑调整回合,这大大缩短了系统运行时间. 第4.2节支持这种观点,因为PoseEngine实现了比GLUEMAP更高的平面姿势精度,累积运行时间也大大降低.

blocks.en: For large-scale scenes, we further provide PoseEngine Flash, which combines FP8/FP16 mixed-precision inference, a simple bundle-adjustment scheme, and system-level optimization of the overall pipeline to substantially reduce runtime and enable fast reconstruction of large scenes.
blocks.zh: 对于大规模场景,我们进一步提供PoseEngine Flash,它结合了FP8/FP16混合精度推论,简单的捆绑调整方案,以及整个管线的系统级优化,以大幅缩短跑取时间并使得能快速地重建大型场景.

blocks.en: The refined cameras condition dense geometry prediction and initialize 3DGS and 4DGS reconstruction. During 3DGS and 4DGS fitting, joint optimization of camera poses and Gaussian parameters can compensate for part of the pose error introduced by faster reconstruction. This enables PoseEngine Flash to support high-quality 3DGS and 4DGS reconstruction while reducing pose-estimation cost.
blocks.zh: 精密相机条件为密密几何预测并初始化了3DGS和4DGS重建. 在3DGS和4DGS相接期间,相机外观和高斯参数的联合优化可以补偿由更快速地重建引入的部分摆式出错. 这使得PoseEngine Flash能够支持高品质的3DGS和4DGS重建,同时降低平面估计成本.

blocks.en: 3.3 KosmoWorld
blocks.zh: 3.3 科斯莫世界组织

blocks.en: KosmoWorld provides high-quality real-world reconstruction data for learning geometric priors. Its pipeline reconstructs real scenes, selects locations with reliable geometry and rendering quality, and generates images with corresponding depth and camera poses along configurable trajectories. The resulting data support diverse viewpoints and camera models while preserving the appearance and geometry of real scenes (Figure 8 ).
blocks.zh: KosmoWorld为学习几何前身提供高质量的现实世界重建数据. 它的管线重建了真实的场景,选择了有可靠的几何和渲染质量的地点,并沿着可配置的轨迹产生具有相应深度和相机的图像. 由此产生的数据支持不同观点和相机模型,同时保留了真实场景的外观和几何特征(图8.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Data Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 数据生成 管道

blocks.en: KosmoWorld builds on WorldNav, the trajectory-planning module introduced in Tencent Hunyuan’s HY-World 2.0 ( Team HY-World, 2026 ) . Our data-generation pipeline applies this planning framework to reconstructed real-world scenes, combining camera-location screening, trajectory planning, and RGB and depth rendering under configurable camera models. Reconstruction quality varies spatially, so the pipeline combines geometric feasibility with observation quality before generating data.
blocks.zh: Kosmo World基于WorldNav, Tencent Hunyuan的HY-World 2.0(Team HY-World, 2026)推出的轨迹规划模块。 我们的数据生成管道将这个规划框架用于重建现实世界的场景,结合相机位置筛选,轨迹规划,以及可配置相机模型下的RGB和深度渲染. 重建质量在空间上有所不同,因此管道在生成数据之前将几何可行性和观测质量结合起来.

blocks.en: Our pipeline first aligns the scene mesh, 3D Gaussians, and capture poses in a shared coordinate frame. A heightfield and navigation mesh built with Recast ( Recast Navigation Contributors, 2026 ) identify candidate regions using slope, step height, vertical clearance, and connectivity. When capture poses are available, probing starts near the captured area and expands to unevaluated locations. An optional constraint limits expansion to the local convex hull of capture positions at compatible heights.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道首先将场景网格, 3D高斯人, 捕获在共享坐标框。 由Recast公司(Recast Navigation Controductions,2026年)建造的高度场和通航网,确定候选区域,使用坡度,步高,垂直通关,并连接. 在有捕捉姿势时,从被捕捉地区附近开始探测并扩张到未评价的地点. 一种可选的制约限制在相容高地上将捕获位置扩张到局部对流船体.

blocks.en: At each probe position, six cube faces cover the viewing sphere and provide RGB, alpha, and depth. Sharpness and local image structure characterize appearance quality, alpha measures rendering coverage, and the fraction of pixels with valid depth measures geometric completeness. Local checks examine the spatial distribution of blur and missing depth to distinguish low-texture surfaces from reconstruction defects. This prevents a strong result in one representation from compensating for a weak result in the other. Under the strict panoramic policy, every required direction must be sampled and pass the quality checks. These scores assess observation quality rather than calibrated probabilities. The usable region contains locations passing both geometric and panoramic checks, with capture support enforced when enabled. Unevaluated locations are excluded from planning.

blocks.en: Four motion profiles provide complementary viewpoint changes. Regular traversal connects the origin to geodesically distant targets in different angular sectors, producing continuous translational parallax. Wandering connects successive goals while favoring unvisited locations and uncovered directions. Landmark orbit connects reachable positions around a supplied 3D target while keeping the camera directed toward it, producing a full orbit or partial arc as space permits. Elevated and variable-height trajectories introduce vertical offsets or connect validated positions at different heights, with geometry and panoramic quality checked again at the new positions.
blocks.zh: 四个运动剖面提供了互补的视角变化. 常规的穿行将起源与不同角相的地缘远去目标相接通,产生连续的翻译参数. 漫游将相继入球相接而来,同时偏好未访问的地点并发现方向. 地标轨道将可到达的位置连接在一个提供的三维目标周围,同时保持相机对准它,在空间允许的情况下产生完整的轨道或部分弧. 高度和可变高度的轨迹引入了垂直相抵或连接不同高地上已确认位置,在新位置再次检查了几何和全景质量.

blocks.en: B-spline smoothing adjusts camera positions, and interpolation along the shortest quaternion arc smooths orientations subject to turn and angular-speed limits. Because smoothing changes the visited positions, the pipeline rechecks geometric sweeps and region constraints along each segment and reassesses panoramic quality at the final sample positions. Failed samples split a route into valid continuous segments. Rendering uses only the trajectories that pass this final validation.

blocks.en: Each RGB frame and its depth supervision share the corresponding camera pose and projection settings. The pipeline records coordinate systems, depth conventions, and valid-image masks so that image content and geometric supervision remain aligned. Depth is derived from the reconstructed scene, making region screening and trajectory validation integral to data quality.
blocks.zh: 每个RGB框架及其深度监督共享相应的相机外观和投影设置. 管道记录协调系统、深度常规和有效图像口罩,以便图像内容和几何监督保持一致。 深度取自于被重建的场景,使得区域筛选和轨迹验证成为数据质量的组成部分.

blocks.en: Outputs are organized into sequences containing images, depth, camera intrinsics and extrinsics, and timestamps. Validation records retain the source scene, trajectory, and sample positions, allowing each training sample to be traced to its generation settings. These image, depth, and camera-pose sequences supplement GFM training.

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 基准

blocks.en: This section evaluates Kosmo-GFM at two levels: GFM’s geometric and motion prediction before scene-level optimization, and PoseEngine’s camera reconstruction accuracy, efficiency, and 3DGS rendering quality. Among the compared methods, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and leading relative-pose results on both SpatialBench Sparse and Medium, together with the lowest average endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow. On the 34 scenes completed by all evaluated systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest mean pose accuracy with lower reconstruction time than GLUEMAP. PoseEngine Flash delivers the fastest reconstruction among the compared systems while retaining complete image registration. These results demonstrate strong geometric prediction and offer complementary choices for reconstruction accuracy and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 本节在以下两个层面对科斯莫-两性平等机制进行评价: GFM在场景水平优化前的几何和运动预测,以及PoseEngine相机重建的精度,效率,和3DGS渲染质量. 在比较方法中,GFM在Space Bench Sparse和Medium上都实现了最小的绝对相对深度误差并领先了相对可控结果,同时在动态点和场景流上也实现了最小的平均端点误差. 在被所有评价系统完成的34个场景上,PoseEngine以比GLUEMAP更低的重建时间实现最高的平面精确度. PoseEngine Flash在比较系统中提供最快的重建,同时保留完整的图像注册. 这些结果显示了强有力的几何预测,并为重建的准确性和效率提供了补充选择。

blocks.en: Dynamic geometry is evaluated on Panoptic Studio ( Joo et al., 2015 ) , PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , Dynamic Replica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) , Aria Digital Twin ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , and SynthVerse ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . The first four datasets follow the WorldTrack evaluation ( Feng et al., 2025 ) used by UniQuery4R ( Chen et al., 2026c ) . The reported average additionally includes SynthVerse. OpenD4RT is an unofficial implementation of D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; OpenD4RT Contributors, 2026 ) , and the reported dynamic results use its 32CLIP variant. We measure dynamic-point APD (Average Percentage of Points within Delta), scene-flow accuracy, and 3D endpoint error (EPE), measured in meters. APD measures the percentage of evaluated dynamic points whose predicted 3D positions lie within a distance threshold of the reference positions, averaged over the evaluation thresholds. It is reported as a percentage, with higher values indicating more accurate point reconstruction. Point EPE measures position error, while flow EPE measures displacement error. Threshold-based accuracy and mean endpoint error capture different aspects of prediction quality. We report scene-flow accuracy (Acc.) as the percentage of predictions with a 3D Euclidean displacement error of at most 0.1 m.

blocks.en: We evaluate 3DGS reconstruction on nine MipNeRF360 and six Tanks & Temples scenes using LiteGS ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . Each model is trained for 30,000 iterations, with every eighth image in filename order held out for evaluation. The reference-pose baseline keeps cameras fixed, whereas other initializations jointly optimize training poses and Gaussians. Before evaluation, each non-reference test pose is refined against its test image for twenty steps with Gaussians and intrinsics fixed. PSNR (dB) and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) measure image fidelity, and VGG LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) measures perceptual distance. These scores evaluate rendering after image-conditioned pose refinement, not fixed-pose generalization. Tanks & Temples uses trajectory-aligned PoseEngine initialization, while MipNeRF360 uses initialization from sparse camera chunks. Comparisons are made within each dataset.

blocks.en: 5 Scaling
blocks.zh: 5 缩放

blocks.en: Given limited open-source 3D training data and our computational resource constraints, we do not establish a quantitative scaling law for GFM. Instead, we examine whether increasing training-data quantity, model scale, and training compute continues to improve depth and camera-pose accuracy within the budgets we can evaluate. After selecting an encoder initialization, we study these three axes using experimental models that are separate from the released GFM. The results show favorable scaling trends overall, with metric-level fluctuations and diminishing gains at larger recurrent depths. These observations motivate further scaling, but do not establish a power-law scaling relationship that can be extrapolated beyond the tested range.
blocks.zh: 鉴于开放源代码3D培训数据有限和我们的计算资源限制,我们没有为GFM制定定量缩放法. 相反,我们审查提高培训数据数量、模型规模和培训计算是否继续提高我们可评估的预算内的深度和摄像机的准确性。 在选择了编码器初始化后,我们使用与所释放的GFM相分离的实验模型来研究这三轴. 结果显示,总体的衡量趋势是有利的,在更频繁的深度,衡量水平波动和收益减少。 这些观测结果激励了进一步的缩放,但并没有建立能被推断出被测试范围以外的电能法缩放关系.

blocks.en: The three sweeps report SpatialBench Sparse depth and camera-pose accuracy in the accompanying plots and tables. Values in the training-compute plots are rounded to three decimal places.
blocks.zh: 三次扫地报告空间奔驰深度和相机在相伴随的地块和桌子上的精确度. 训练-计算图中的数值被四舍五入到小数点后三个位数。

blocks.en: 5.1 Encoder Selection
blocks.zh: 5.1 编码器选择

blocks.en: GFM models rely on visual encoders initialized from pretrained models such as DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) . The available pretrained checkpoints therefore constrain the model scales that can be studied directly.
blocks.zh: GFM模型依赖于从DINOv2等预先训练过的模型中初始化的视觉编码器(Oquab等,2024年). 因此,现有的事先经过训练的检查站限制了可直接研究的模型尺度。

blocks.en: We compare the Base variants of DINOv2, DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , and LingBot-Vision ( Fu et al., 2026 ) as encoder initializations, training base-size reconstruction models for 100k iterations on Hypersim ( Roberts et al., 2021 ) with 2–24 input views. LingBot-Vision performs best among the three general-purpose encoders across the reported depth and pose measures (Table 13 ). We therefore use pretrained weights from the LingBot-Vision family to initialize the encoders in the subsequent scaling experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了DINov2,DINov3(Siméoni等,2026年)和LingBot-Vision(Fu等,2026年)的基础变体作为编码器初始化,Hypersim(Roberts等,2021年)上100克迭代的培训基大小重建模型,与2–24个输入视图. 灵灵 瓶-图像在报告的深度的3个通用编码器中表现最佳,并提出了措施(表13)。 因此,我们使用由LingBot-Vision家族预先培养的分量来初始化编码器在之后的缩放实验中.

The geometry-pretrained Depth Anything 3-Base encoder is listed as a reference. Bold marks the best value among the three general-purpose encoders.
blocks.zh: 表13:缩放模型的编码器初始化. 基础大小的重建模型由每个预先训练的编码器的基数变体初始化,并在Hypersim上为100克重联进行训练,并有2–24个输入视图. 几何预导深度 Anything 3-Base编码器被列为参考. 粗体标出三个通用编码器中的最佳值.

blocks.en: To study intermediate scales without separately pretraining larger visual encoders, we adopt a recurrent-depth Transformer approach that reuses the 1.7B model’s weights across additional computational depth. This produces the 2.5B, 3.2B, and 4.8B variants evaluated below. For these recurrent variants, the reported scale counts parameter uses in the expanded computation graph, including repeated uses of shared weights; it is not the number of independent trainable parameters. These variants let us probe scaling through increased recurrent computation while retaining the available pretrained initialization.
blocks.zh: 为了研究中间尺度,而不单独预先训练更大的视觉编码器,我们采取了反复深入的变形器方法,在额外的计算深度中重新使用1.7B模型的权重。 这产生了下文评价的2.5B、3.2B和4.8B等变体。 对于这些经常性变体,所报的尺度计算了扩大计算图中的参数使用量,包括共享权重的重复使用;它不是独立可列车参数的数量. 这些变体使我们能够通过增加的经常性计算来探索缩放,同时保留现有的经过预先培训的初始化。

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Compute
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训计算

blocks.en: We evaluate training-compute scaling for four model configurations, fixing the training length at 200,000 steps and increasing the GPU count from 8 to 16 and 32. Figure 16 uses GPU count multiplied by training steps as a budget proxy, corresponding to 1.6M, 3.2M, and 6.4M GPU-steps. We use this proxy to organize the budget sweep within each model configuration; the 3.2B configuration uses recurrent depth as described in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价四个模式配置的培训计算比例,将培训长度固定在20万个步骤上,并将GPU的计数从8个增加到16个和32个。 图16采用GPU计数乘以培训步骤作为预算代用,对应1.6M,3.2M和6.4M GPU步. 我们使用这个代理来组织每个模型配置内的预算扫描;3.2B配置使用第5.1节所描述的经常性深度.

blocks.en: Figure 16: Training-compute scaling across four model scales. Each series uses 200k training steps with 8, 16, or 32 GPUs; the horizontal axis reports the corresponding GPU-step budget.
blocks.zh: 图16:培训计算分四个模式规模。 每个系列使用200k训练步骤并配有8个16个或32个GPU;水平轴报告对应的GPU步预算.

blocks.en: Increasing training compute generally reduces depth error and improves camera-pose accuracy, although individual metrics fluctuate. For the 3.2B variant, however, gains become smaller at higher budgets, suggesting a trend toward saturation.
blocks.zh: 增加训练计算一般会减少深度误差并改进相机的准确性,尽管个别的度量衡波动. 然而,就3.2B的变式而言,在较高预算情况下收益会更小,这表明了饱和的趋势。

blocks.en: Two hypotheses. We consider two possible explanations for this trend. First, the current training set of 187,880 trajectories may be insufficient in size or diversity to support further improvements at this model scale. Second, repeated applications of shared Transformer weights may yield progressively smaller representational updates as recurrent depth increases, reducing the gains from additional passes. We refer to this possible effect as recurrent “inertia.”
blocks.zh: 二假说. 我们认为这种趋势有两个可能的解释。 首先,目前187 880个轨迹的培训组规模或多样性可能不足以支持这一模型规模的进一步改进。 第二,重复应用共享变压器权重可能会随着经常深度增加而使代表性更新逐渐减少,从而减少额外通行证带来的收益。 我们把这种可能的影响称为反复出现的“非正常现象”。 “

blocks.en: Additional recurrent-depth experiments. To further examine the second hypothesis, we extend the model-scale comparison in Section 5.3 to the 4.8B recurrent variant, alongside the 2.5B and 3.2B variants (Figure 17 ). All variants are trained on the full set of 187,880 trajectories using 8 GPUs and 200k steps. The recurrent variants share the 1.7B model’s weights and follow the scale convention defined in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 额外的反复深入实验. 为了进一步审查第二种假设,我们把第5.3节中的模型尺度比较扩大到了4.8B的经常变体,以及2.5B和3.2B变体(图17)。 所有变体都使用8个GPU和200k步来对187,880个轨迹全集进行训练. 经常变体与1.7B模型的权重相同,并遵循第5.1节所定义的比额表惯例。

blocks.en: The results show that increasing recurrent depth continues to improve accuracy, while the gains per increment in scale become smaller, particularly for AbsRel and AUC@30. From 3.2B to 4.8B, AbsRel decreases from 0.2067 to 0.2049, AUC@30 increases from 0.6898 to 0.7007, and AUC@5 increases from 0.3008 to 0.3216. This trend is consistent with diminishing marginal returns from recurrent depth.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,不断提高的深度继续提高准确性,而比额表的增量收益会减少,特别是AbsRel和AUC@30。 从3.2B到4.8B,AbsRel从0.2067降至0.2049,AUC@30从0.6898增至0.707,AUC@5从0.3008增至0.3216。 这一趋势与经常性深度的边际收益减少相一致。

blocks.en: Figure 17: Recurrent-depth scaling using 8 GPUs for 200k steps. The 2.5B, 3.2B, and 4.8B variants reuse the 1.7B model’s weights; their reported scales count parameter uses in the expanded computation graph, including weight reuse, rather than unique trainable parameters. The 0.6B and 1.7B models serve as references. Accuracy continues to improve at larger scales, with diminishing marginal gains.
blocks.zh: 图17:使用8个GPU进行200k步的经常性深度缩放. 2.5B,3.2B和4.8B等变体再用1.7B模型的权重;它们报告的尺度计算参数在扩大的计算图中的用法,包括权重再用,而不是独特的可训练参数. 0.6B和1.7B模型作为参考。 准确度在更大范围内继续提高,边际收益正在减少。

blocks.en: Related work and outlook. Related observations have been reported in other multi-view reconstruction models. Déjà View ( Burzio et al., 2026 ) observes decreasing relative feature updates and reports a plateau beyond the trained iteration budget under a stabilization recipe. Solv3R ( Kwak et al., 2026 ) reports diminishing state updates and camera errors that stabilize with continued iteration. The favorable trends observed in this section support further exploration of data, model, and compute scaling. We remain optimistic about recurrent depth as a practical way to increase computation through weight reuse, and will continue investigating larger training sets and improved recurrence designs. Establishing a quantitative scaling law remains a goal for experiments spanning a wider range of data and compute budgets.
blocks.zh: 相关工作与展望. 其他多景区重建模式也报告了相关观测结果. Déjà View(Burzio等,2026年)观察到相对特征更新不断减少,并报告说,在稳定办法下,一个高地超出了训练有素的重复预算。 Solv3R(Kwak等,2026年)报告说,状态更新减少,相机出错随着持续迭代而稳定. 本节中观察到的有利趋势有助于进一步探索数据、模型和计算尺度。 我们仍然乐观地认为,经常性的深度是通过再利用重量来增加计算的实际方法,并将继续调查更大的培训组合和改进的再生设计。 制定定量比例法仍然是涵盖更广泛的数据和计算预算的实验目标。

blocks.en: 6 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 6 定性结果

blocks.en: This section illustrates the range of reconstruction outputs supported by Kosmo-GFM on public datasets and captured sequences: camera trajectories, sparse and dense geometry, feed-forward 3DGS, 3DGS, dynamic points, and 4DGS. Camera-conditioned prediction incorporates recovered camera information into dense geometry and renderable scene representations, while the dynamic examples illustrate scene structure and motion over time. These qualitative results show the workflow from camera recovery to geometry reconstruction and rendering, demonstrate support for multiple reconstruction tasks and output representations, and complement the preceding quantitative evaluations.
blocks.zh: 本节说明Kosmo-GFM在公共数据集和捕获序列方面支持的重建产出范围:相机轨迹、稀疏密几何、向导3DGS、3DGS、动态点和4DGS。 相机条件化的预测将所回收的相机信息融入了密集的几何和可渲染的场景表现,而动态的例子则说明了场景结构和随时间推移而移动. 这些定性结果表明从相机恢复到几何重建和渲染的工作流程,表明对多项重建任务和产出表述的支持,并补充了之前的定量评价.

blocks.en: 6.3 Feed-Forward 3DGS

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Kosmo-GFM combines learned geometric priors with scene-level optimization to support both static and dynamic reconstruction. We discuss limitations in static 3D geometry and dynamic 4D modeling separately, then consider applications and representation-learning opportunities enabled by 3D point tracking.
blocks.zh: Kosmo-GFM将所学几何前缀与场景级优化相结合,支持静态和动态重建. 我们分别讨论静态三维几何和动态四维模型的局限性,再考虑三维点跟踪所允许的应用和表现-学习机会.

blocks.en: 7.1 Static 3D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 7.1 静态立体重建

blocks.en: Textureless scenes. Large blank surfaces offer few distinctive features or reliable cross-view correspondences. The resulting lack of visual constraints makes camera recovery unreliable, as illustrated by the stairwell example in Figure 24 (a).
blocks.zh: 无纹理场景. 巨大的空白表面几乎没有显著的特征或可靠的交叉视图通信. 如图24(a)所显示的,由此造成的视觉限制的缺乏使相机恢复不可靠。

blocks.en: Portrait-oriented inputs. Our training primarily targets landscape-oriented images and videos. Portrait-oriented inputs are less well covered during training, resulting in weaker reconstruction performance, as illustrated by the indoor video in Figure 24 (b).
blocks.zh: 以肖像为导向的投入. 我们的培训主要针对面向景观的图像和视频。 如图24(b)所显示的,在培训期间,面向画像的投入覆盖面较小,导致重建绩效减弱。

blocks.en: Unstructured photo collections. Training data emphasize walkthrough trajectories, whereas independently captured Internet photos vary substantially in viewpoint, framing, appearance, and view overlap. Limited training coverage of these capture patterns reduces robustness on datasets such as MegaDepth ( Li and Snavely, 2018 ) , MegaDepth-X ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and ArchWorld ( Kriplani et al., 2026 ) . Figure 24 (c) illustrates the resulting errors in recovered camera poses on 7 West 54th Street.

blocks.en:
Decoder context and temporal conditioning. Our dynamic-point decoder adopts the source-to-target formulation of
UniQuery4R ( Chen et al., 2026c ) : a query sampled from the source-frame
features cross-attends to the selected target-frame features.
D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) instead lets a source-point query, augmented
with local appearance, attend to a global representation of all input
frames, using a learned target-time embedding to specify the requested
temporal state. In our formulation, global attention in the encoder
already exchanges information across all input frames. The selected
source and target representations therefore provide a compact interface
to this multi-frame context, reducing the information explicitly accessed
by the decoder. Our design hypothesis is that this encoder-level
aggregation can make additional attention to other frames unnecessary
at decoding time; this remains to be established through controlled
ablations. Selecting the target features also identifies the requested
frame directly, removing dependence on a learned target-time embedding
indexed by a predefined frame set.

confidence-weighted trajectories can supervise Gaussian motion. Frame interpolation. Estimated trajectories can support frame interpolation by interpolating

intermediate times, with visibility handling and image completion for
newly exposed regions. Camera reshooting. Holo4D ( Lan et al., 2026a ) , for example, projects persistent 3D

for preserving motion and identity during video reshooting, beyond the
spatial information in independent point clouds.

blocks.en: Overall, Kosmo-GFM combines multi-task geometric prediction, scene-level camera recovery, and real-world supervision to support static and dynamic reconstruction. The reported accuracy, efficiency, and scaling results motivate extending this framework to a wider range of real-world capture conditions.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,科斯莫-GFM结合了多任务几何预测,场景级相机恢复,以及现实世界的监督,以支持静态和动态重建. 报告的准确性、效率和成果的扩大促使将这一框架扩大到更广泛的现实世界捕捉条件。
